items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I'm talking with a dear friend, Tom Whaley... and Tom and I have been knowing one another way over 50 years

ctx.x: I'm talking to Tom Whaley, great musician, one of the mainstays of music and musicians in New York City for many, many years and today is March 17, 1979 and I'm talking with a dear friend, Tom Whaley, and my name is Milt Hinton and Tom and I have been knowing one another way over 50 years, is that so, Tom. Way over 50 years you and I have been knocking around together and we're doing this for the Smithsonian Institute, Tom, and for oral history so that young people in the future will know about you because we are…

I was born in Boston at the corner of Church and Melrose in 1892. And my father and mother moved to Boston after six months of living there, I mean to Everett, Massachusetts. It's about six or seven miles from Boston, just like from New York to Brooklyn. And well, the first thing I remember was in 1895 the subway opened and my mother and father went on the opening ride and the burglars broke in the house and my sister put us all in a room and told us to keep still and I think something

items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yeah but you were shocked, Tom Whaley. Tom said, “You want me to conduct?”

ctx.x: Jim Hall. It was a most auspicious night. It was auspicious because you got up and sang that —
Oh, yeah but you were shocked, Tom Whaley. Tom said, “You want me to conduct?” I said, “You made the arrangements, why don’t you conduct it?” Oh, man.

Well I’ve been a lucky dude, because I talk like my sister, Pearl Bailey always says, “I’ve been to the White House so many times I just call it ‘The House.’” So I’ve been in there, and everybody knew me pretty well, and I always had a camera, and everybody was looking at me going around with the cameras you know. So when jam sessions got to be going, I handed somebody else the bass, and I had my camera and I went around, and I really took some pictures. I took some pictures that I really love. I’ve got pictures…
